messages:
carol: FYI planning to publish py/ts SDK today 10:00 PST. We need final pin decision for sync-client compatibility and dist-tag handshake. Deploybot scheduled at 10:15. Any blockers?
ben: quick check — signing creds rotated last night. I pushed updated GH secret `PYPI_TOKEN_RELEASE`. Make sure shiproom has it.
alice: Can we shadow publish to `staging` dist-tag first, smoke tests for 15m, then flip to `latest`? :thumbsup:
ben: yes — my plan: publish to `staging`, run `smoke/publish-checks` job, then dist-tag move if green.
deploybot: Deploy job queued: id=r-20260321-113, scheduled=10:15 PST, artifacts=py-wheel,ts-npm. Will post status updates.
dave: Rollback criteria: any publish-checks failure, or >5% telemetry errors in 10m window after traffic shift. Rollback steps below.
carol: Add release notes: deprecate `sync-client` shim in next major. Need short migration blurb and changelog entry.
alice: I'll draft the deprec note in docs PR #462 today.
ben: One more - npm signer drift was flakey last week. For npm we will keep `dist-tag` shadow path. If signer mismatch -> hold and contact infra.
carol: Good. For pinning: pin py client 1.x for internal customers, unpin for free tier. Document in release notes.
ben: rollback command examples:
```bash
# remove latest tag, restore previous
npm dist-tag add @our/sdk@1.4.3 latest
twine upload --repository-url https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/our_sdk-1.4.3-py3-none-any.whl
```
dave: Also adding immediate revoke in case of secret leak:
```bash
# revoke token
gh secret set -R org -a PYPI_TOKEN_RELEASE --visibility=none
# yank pypi
python -m pip index versions our-sdk
# file an emergency issue in #incidents
```
deploybot: Job r-20260321-113 started
carol: thanks — if green we'll post release notes and add deprecation banner. I'll monitor the logs. :eyes:
ben: standing by for canary results.
dave: if we see problems, I'll run the rollback and ping legal/security if token exposure suspected. done.
